request_contract.parameter_rules: Documented exact path only. No execution authorized by this contract; review provider terms, fixed request and bounded acquisition plan before activation.

response_contract.format: HDF5 orbital swaths, nominal 5 km footprints; V07 hail classification
response_contract.scientific_semantics: Catalogue https://disc.gsfc.nasa.gov/datasets/GPM_2ADPR_07/summary; algorithm basis https://gpm.nasa.gov/sites/default/files/2022-06/ATBD_DPR_V07A.pdf. flagHail/flagGraupelHail are algorithmic hydrometeor indicators, not ground diameter. Validate exact field path and flags with small authenticated subset before bulk download; full granules large. Orbit sampling, attenuation and nonuniform beam filling matter.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No new automated requests authorized. Future route must review service terms and enforce explicit provider-specific request and byte limits.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: Freeze exact version, UTC retrieval time, selected object, response byte size, SHA-256 and coverage; never use a mutable directory or catalogue as original byte identity.

rights_and_policy.notes: Earthdata account and exact V07 field path, units and product terms needed; seek small OPeNDAP subset, not 400 MB full orbit; validate flagHail against independent ground labels.
